name: psyllium husk
uses: Uses: ▪ for relief of occasional constipation (irregularity)
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if you have ▪ a sudden change in bowel habits persisting for 2 weeks ▪ abdominal pain, nausea or vomiting Stop use and ask a doctor if ▪ constipation lasts more than 7 days ▪ rectal bleeding occurs These may be signs of a serious condition.
